# .filing — how this project tracks itself

Run every command from the project root, in any shell (PowerShell, cmd, bash, zsh): `node .filing/filing.mjs <command>`.
Set `FILING_WHO=<name>` so the ledger, leases and the merge lane say who acted.

| You want to | Run |
|---|---|
| See what is current, what is in progress, git state, next command | `status` |
| See the evidence the AGENTS.md card is built from (schedules, config, outputs, runbooks) | `facts` |
| Rebuild the card and the index after editing STATUS, a schedule or config, or after a merge | `render` |
| Add work | `item add "<title>" --home <file> [--pkg <dir>] [--files a,b]` |
| Start / finish / drop work | `item start <id>` / `item done <id>` / `item drop <id> --why "<reason>"` |
| Leave a note on an item (touches one file) | `item note <id> "<text>"` |
| Prove the docs are true | `check` (exit 0 = green; `--strict` also fails on stale docs; `--cold` shows where each standard question is answered) |
| Replace a doc (moved byte for byte, hash recorded) | `archive <old> --by <new>` |
| Reorganise files | `survey --out plan.json`, review `plan.md`, then `apply plan.json --yes`; reverse with `undo` |
| Find branches already merged (including squash merges) | `refs` |
| End a session | `close "<summary>" --next "<exact command>" --verified "<claim> — <how>" --unverified "<claim>"` |
| One merger at a time on main | `lane claim "<why>"` / `lane release` |

Files: `ledger.jsonl` (append-only, merges with `merge=union`), `config.json` (layout, packages, pinned globs),
`journal/` (apply journals for undo; gitignored). Generated: the card in `AGENTS.md`, and `docs/INDEX.md`.
Owner-written: `docs/STATUS.md`. Nothing here deletes files: superseded docs go to `docs/archive/`.
